decisionBox.changed: Position moves from midday's ADD to REDUCE, and it moves because midday's own protective gate fired. Midday set reduce at a settled 1H close below the daily EMA20 at 77,176.4; the 18:00Z hour closed 77,059.9, and 21:00Z at 77,119.0 and 22:00Z at 77,147.4 closed below it as well - three settled closes through the gate. Midday's 78,066.5 add gate did NOT fire: the best settled close since was 77,532.2, short by 534.3 points, and the only tag of 78,066.5 happened BEFORE the midday mark was taken. So of the two gates midday published, the one that fired was the protective one, and yesterday's logged lesson says obey that one first. Three pieces of evidence back the stance rather than just the gate. Tonight's liquidation window is 2,397,252 USD of which 2,240,363 USD, 93.5 percent, was LONG-side - five times midday's total window and a return to the one-way bleed that midday had declared over. The long/short account ratio has gone the wrong way, from 1.50 at midday to 1.63 at the 00:00Z bar, a NEW high above the 1.61 midnight peak, so accounts are re-loading long into weakness immediately after being flushed. And the US 10-year printed another 52-week high at 4.971 percent with rate-hike odds now above 85 percent into Wednesday's FOMC. Against all that: open interest keeps draining, 2,096,470,458 USD, down 2.39 percent from midday and 6.50 percent from midnight, and price still closes the day above all four daily EMAs. That mix justifies trimming a slice and holding the core, not abandoning the book.

overnightRisk: The gap runs from 19:41 COT tonight to the roughly 02:00 COT midnight report, and it opens the WEEKEND tape - the thinnest book of the week, with US ETF creation and redemption shut until Monday. That matters more than usual tonight for three specific reasons. First, the densest measured liquidation shelf of the week sits 370 to 470 points below spot: 1,354,495 USD filled in the 76,800 to 76,899 band and another 609,626 USD in 76,900 to 76,999, together 82 percent of the night's 2,397,252 USD window, and the session low of 76,880.1 sits inside it. Thin weekend liquidity plus a magnet that close is exactly the configuration that produces a 2am wick. Second, the crowd is re-loaded on the wrong side: the long/short account ratio is 1.63, a new high above the 1.61 midnight peak, set immediately after 93.5 percent of tonight's liquidations were longs. A crowd that re-buys within hours of being flushed usually gets flushed again. Third, the rates backdrop is still tightening - US 10-year at 4.971 percent, another 52-week high, DXY 99.095, and traders pricing a Fed HIKE on Wednesday - while equities rallied today (QQQ plus 0.87 percent, VOO plus 0.85 percent) and BTC did not follow. Crypto stopped tracking the risk bid today, which removes the one prop that carried it through Thursday. What would make this benign: open interest has now drained 6.50 percent in a day, funding is essentially flat at plus 0.0024 percent, and the ETF tape printed a partial plus 6.0 million for 11 September, its first non-negative row in four sessions, though IBIT has still not reported. The concrete plan is the resting stop at 76,740.0 described in the decision box - placed BELOW the 76,800 magnet on purpose so a wick into the cluster does not fire it, but a genuine break of the shelf does.

liquidityMagnet.note: By distance the two nearest bands are noise - 130 points above and 170 points below. The content is the imbalance. 2,240,363 USD of the 2,397,252 USD window was LONG-side, 93.5 percent, and every long band sits below price; the entire short side is 156,889 USD in one band overhead. The honest caveat is unchanged and it matters more tonight than usual: these are REALISED fills, so the 76,800 shelf describes leverage that has already been cleared, not stops waiting to be run. calibration.note: Midday published reduce at a settled 1H close below 77,176.4 and add at a settled 1H close above 78,066.5. The reduce gate FIRED three times - 18:00Z at 77,059.9, 21:00Z at 77,119.0, 22:00Z at 77,147.4. The add gate did NOT fire; the best settled close was 77,532.2, short by 534.3 points, and the only tag of 78,066.5 came before the midday mark was even taken, which means midday published as its trigger a level that had ALREADY been rejected that hour. That is the correctable mistake, not the direction. The 76,001.0 invalidation was never approached - the low was 76,880.1, holding 879.1 points above it - and midday's DECLINED resting stop at 75,950.0 would not have filled, so declining was right for the sixth time in seven sessions. Discretionary: midday ADDED 15.00 USDT of spot at 77,540.6 and spot marks 77,270.0, 270.6 points and 0.35 percent offside, roughly minus 0.05 USDT on that tranche. Seven hours is too short to grade a position-sized buy, so score the gate discipline rather than the tranche: the protective gate was the one that fired, and endday is acting on it.
